answer.new_information: NVIDIA describes a new business model in which AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure for AI-native, enterprise and ISV customers under a revenue-sharing and credit-support structure, with NVIDIA earning standard product revenue plus a share of cloud revenue on supported capacity. No dollar amounts, share percentages, customer counts, or deployment timelines are stated, and the record is a party statement with no independent verification. The Firmus Batam figures (360 MW, up to 170,000 GPUs) are 'expected' scale, not delivered capacity.
answer.reason: No catalog questions or stored pieces exist, so there is no argument to update. The record is a vendor-authored business-model announcement with no sizes, shares, or timelines; it is context rather than a number that moves an existing question. It may merit a future question on NVIDIA's revenue-sharing and credit-support exposure (circularity and recurring-revenue mix), but the texts do not yet quantify that exposure, so I am not proposing a new question on this record alone.
